name: FTP
label: FTP / SFTP file transfer
description: List/download/upload/delete/rename on SFTP (preferred), explicit FTPS (AUTH TLS + PROT P), or plain FTP (only when allow_plain_ftp=true). Handler FtpNode. Download/upload use type file. SFTP requires known_hosts. Not an HTML scraper.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One FTP operation. Purpose fields (host, remote_path, new_path, file) override config when set. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'list'.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: list | download | upload | delete | rename. Overrides config operation when set.

schema.label: host
schema.description: Server hostname or IP for this invoke. Overrides config host when set.

schema.label: remote_path
schema.description: Remote path. Path segment '..' is rejected.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref for upload (input). Type file.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: list | download | upload | delete | rename. Required. Example: 'list'.

configurationParameters.label: Protocol
configurationParameters.description: sftp (preferred, default) | ftps (explicit AUTH TLS + PROT P) | ftp (cleartext RFC 959, requires allow_plain_ftp=true). Default sftp.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: Password. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Private Key
configurationParameters.description: SFTP private key PEM. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Passphrase
configurationParameters.description: Passphrase for an encrypted SFTP private_key. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Known Hosts
configurationParameters.description: SFTP only. OpenSSH known_hosts content or host-key fingerprint. Required for sftp. Unknown or mismatched keys are refused.

configurationParameters.label: Allow Plain FTP
configurationParameters.description: Permit cleartext FTP (protocol=ftp). Default false. Required true before a non-TLS FTP connection is opened.

configurationParameters.label: Passive
configurationParameters.description: FTP passive mode. Default true. Active FTP (PORT) is not supported.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25, cap 60. Example: 25.
